literal: Shengzong, Part Six
idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Six

literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on xinhai new moon, did not accept congratulations.
idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, on the xinhai new moon of the first spring month the court declined congratulatory rites.

literal: On jiayin day, went to Qian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor went to Qian Mausoleum.

literal: On guiyou day, enshrined the late Empress Dowager's coffin at the Temporary Enclosure Hall in Qian Prefecture.
idiomatic: On guiyou day the late Empress Dowager's coffin was enshrined at the Temporary Enclosure Hall in Qian Prefecture.

literal: In the second month, on bingxu day, Song dispatched Wang Sui, Wang Ru and others to come mourn and sacrifice.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the second month Song sent Wang Sui, Wang Ru, and others to offer mourning sacrifices.

literal: On jihai day, Goryeo dispatched Wei Shouyu and others to come sacrifice.
idiomatic: On jihai day Goryeo sent Wei Shouyu and others to present offerings.

literal: That month, dispatched Left Dragon-Tiger Guard senior general Xiao Hezhuo to present the late Empress Dowager's keepsakes to Song, also dispatched Linhai Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie, Left Leading Army Guard senior general Zhang Chongji to thank Song for mourning and sacrifice.
idiomatic: That month Left Dragon-Tiger Guard senior general Xiao Hezhuo was sent with the late Empress Dowager's belongings to Song, while Linhai Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie and Left Leading Army Guard senior general Zhang Chongji were dispatched to thank Song for its mourning envoys.

literal: In the third month, on guimao day, conferred posthumous title on the late Empress Dowager as Empress Shenshen Xuanxian.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the third month the late Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Empress Shenshen Xuanxian.

literal: That month, Song and Goryeo dispatched envoys to come attend burial.
idiomatic: That month Song and Goryeo sent envoys to attend the burial.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on jiazi day, buried the Empress Dowager at Qian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the fourth summer month the Empress Dowager was buried at Qian Mausoleum.

literal: Granted Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang the name Longyun.
idiomatic: Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang was granted the name Longyun.

literal: On gengwu day, granted residence and burial land.
idiomatic: On gengwu day he was granted a residence and land for burial accompaniment.

literal: In the fifth month, on jimao new moon, went to Central Capital.
idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the fifth month the court went to the Central Capital.

literal: On xinmao day, summer coolness at Qijin Mountain.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the court took the summer retreat at Qijin Mountain.

literal: On yisi day, Northwestern Pacification Commission commissioner Xiao Tuyu memorialized attacking Ganzhou Uyghur, broke Xiaozhou, captured all its people.
idiomatic: On yisi day Northwestern Pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu reported an attack on the Ganzhou Uyghur in which Xiaozhou was taken and its entire population captured.

literal: An edict ordered repairing Turuikou old city to garrison it.
idiomatic: An edict ordered the old city at Turuikou repaired and populated.

literal: On bingwu day, Goryeo Western Capital military governor Kang Zhao assassinated his lord King Song, on his own authority installed Song's cousin King Xun; edict ordered various circuits to prepare armor and weapons, to prepare for eastern campaign.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Goryeo Western Capital governor Kang Zhao murdered King Song and installed Song's cousin King Xun without authorization; an edict ordered all circuits to ready arms for an eastern expedition.

literal: In autumn, eighth month, on wushen day, relieved Ping Prefecture famine victims.
idiomatic: On wushen day in the eighth autumn month famine relief was distributed at Ping Prefecture.

literal: On xinhai day, favored visit to Central Capital.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the court visited the Central Capital.

literal: On bingyin day, paid respects at Xian and Qian Mausoleums.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the Emperor visited the Xian and Qian mausoleums.

literal: On dingmao day, personally led campaign against Goryeo, dispatched envoys to notify Song.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the Emperor personally led a campaign against Goryeo and sent envoys to inform Song.

literal: Made the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou remain to guard the capital, Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Xiao Paia as supreme commander, Northern Privy Chancellor Sengnu as inspector general.
idiomatic: Prince of Chu Longyou was left to guard the capital; Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Xiao Paia was made supreme commander, and Northern Privy Chancellor Sengnu inspector general.

literal: In the ninth month, on yiyou day, dispatched envoys to invest Western Peace King Li Dezhao as King of Xia.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the ninth month envoys were sent to invest Western Peace King Li Dezhao as King of Xia.

literal: On xinmao day, dispatched Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng, Introducing Commissioner Han Qi to question Goryeo King Xun.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng and Introducing Commissioner Han Qi were dispatched to question Goryeo King Xun.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on bingwu new moon, Jurchen presented ten thousand good horses, begged to follow campaign against Goryeo; permitted.
idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the tenth winter month the Jurchen presented ten thousand fine horses and asked to join the Goryeo campaign; permission was granted.

literal: King Xun dispatched envoys submitting a memorial begging withdrawal of army; not permitted.
idiomatic: King Xun sent envoys begging the army be withdrawn; the request was refused.

literal: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, the great army crossed the Yalu River; Kang Zhao resisted battle, was defeated, withdrew to defend Tong Prefecture.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the eleventh month the main army crossed the Yalu River; Kang Zhao offered battle, was defeated, and fell back to defend Tong Prefecture.

literal: On bingxu day, Zhao again came out; Right Pishi xiangwen Yelü Dilu captured Zhao and vice general Li Li, pursued and killed for several tens of li, captured abandoned grain supplies and armor and weapons.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Kang Zhao sallied forth again; Right Pishi xiangwen Yelü Dilu captured him and vice general Li Li, pursued the enemy for several tens of li, and seized abandoned provisions, armor, and weapons.

literal: On wuzi day, Tong, Huo, Gui, Ning and other prefectures all surrendered.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Tong, Huo, Gui, Ning, and other prefectures all surrendered.

literal: Paia reached Nuguda Ridge, encountered enemy troops, battled and defeated them.
idiomatic: Xiao Paia reached Nuguda Ridge, met enemy forces, and defeated them in battle.

literal: On xinmao day, King Xun dispatched envoys submitting a memorial requesting audience; permitted.
idiomatic: On xinmao day King Xun sent envoys requesting an audience; the request was granted.

literal: Forbade army soldiers captive plunder.
idiomatic: Soldiers were forbidden to plunder captives.

literal: Made Administrative Clerk Ma Baoyou Kaegyeong garrison commander, An Prefecture regiment trainer Wang Ba as vice garrison commander.
idiomatic: Administrative Clerk Ma Baoyou was made Kaegyeong garrison commander and An Prefecture regiment trainer Wang Ba vice garrison commander.

literal: Dispatched Crown Prince Grand Tutor Yi Lin to lead one thousand cavalry, escort Baoyou and others to the capital.
idiomatic: Crown Prince Grand Tutor Yi Lin was sent with one thousand cavalry to escort Baoyou and the others to the capital.

literal: On renchen day, garrison commander Zhuo Sizheng killed Liao envoys Han Xisun and ten others, led troops out to resist; Baoyou and others returned.
idiomatic: On renchen day garrison commander Zhuo Sizheng killed Liao envoys Han Xisun and ten others and led troops out to resist; Baoyou and the others withdrew.

literal: Dispatched Yi Lin to lead troops to attack him; Sizheng then fled to Western Capital.
idiomatic: Yi Lin was dispatched to attack him with troops; Sizheng then fled to the Western Capital.

literal: Besieged it, five days without taking it.
idiomatic: The city was besieged for five days without being taken.

literal: Imperial halt west of the city.
idiomatic: The court encamped west of the city.

literal: Goryeo Ministry of Rites middle-rank official Bohai Tuoshi came and surrendered.
idiomatic: Bohai Tuoshi, a middle-rank official of Goryeo's Ministry of Rites, came over and surrendered.

literal: On gengzi day, dispatched Paia, Penu and others to attack Kaegyeong, encountered Goryeo troops, defeated them.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Xiao Paia, Penu, and others were sent to attack Kaegyeong, met Goryeo troops, and defeated them.

literal: King Xun abandoned the city and fled; then burned Kaegyeong, reached Qing River, returned.
idiomatic: King Xun abandoned the city and fled; Kaegyeong was then burned, and the army reached Qing River before turning back.

literal: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, on yihai new moon, army withdrew; the surrendered cities all rebelled again.
idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, on the yihai new moon of the first spring month the army withdrew; the cities that had surrendered all rebelled again.

literal: Reaching Gui Prefecture's Nanjun Ridge valley, heavy rain for many days, horses and camels all exhausted, armor and weapons mostly abandoned; after clearing weather then able to cross.
idiomatic: At Nanjun Ridge valley south of Gui Prefecture it rained heavily for many days; horses and camels were exhausted and much armor and equipment was abandoned before the army could cross once the weather cleared.

literal: On jichou day, halted at Yalu River.
idiomatic: On jichou day the army halted at the Yalu River.

literal: On gengyin day, Empress and the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou welcomed at Laiyuan City.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the Empress and Prince of Chu Longyou welcomed the court at Laiyuan City.

literal: On renchen day, edict disbanded the various armies.
idiomatic: On renchen day an edict ordered all armies disbanded.

literal: On jihai day, halted at Eastern Capital.
idiomatic: On jihai day the court halted at the Eastern Capital.

literal: In the second month, on jiyou day, visited Qian and Xian Mausoleums.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the second month the Emperor visited the Qian and Xian mausoleums.

literal: On wuwu day, captured Goryeo people were distributed and assigned to various mausoleum temples; the remainder granted to inner kin and great ministers.
idiomatic: On wuwu day captured Goryeo people were assigned to the various mausoleum temples, and the remainder were granted to imperial in-laws and senior ministers.

literal: In the third month, on jimao day, Grand Chancellor King of Jin Yelü Longyun died.
idiomatic: On jimao day of the third month Grand Chancellor King of Jin Yelü Longyun died.

literal: On gengchen day, the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou was provisional Northern Privy Commissioner, Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng was Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Prince of Chu Longyou was made provisional Northern Privy Commissioner and Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.

literal: On gengyin day, Nanjing and Ping Prefecture flood, relief given.
idiomatic: On gengyin day flooding at Nanjing and Ping Prefecture was met with relief.

literal: On jihai day, Northern Chancellery Great King Yelü Shilu was made Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed King of Han, Northern Chancellery langjun Yelü Shiliang was Northern Chancellery Great King, former Three Departments commissioner Liu Shenxing was Associate Administrative Affairs commissioner and concurrently Southern Privy Commissioner.
idiomatic: On jihai day Northern Chancellery Great King Yelü Shilu was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed King of Han; Northern Chancellery langjun Yelü Shiliang was made Northern Chancellery Great King; and former Three Departments commissioner Liu Shenxing was appointed associate administrative affairs commissioner and concurrent Southern Privy Commissioner.

literal: In summer, fourth month, summer coolness at Laogu Marsh.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Laogu Marsh.

literal: In the fifth month, on jiaxu new moon, edict ordered already submitted matters sent to the relevant offices to be appended to the calendar.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the fifth month an edict ordered matters already submitted to the relevant offices to be appended to the court calendar.

literal: Also edict ordered tent clans with crimes, tattoo ink according to the various tribes' precedent.
idiomatic: An edict also ordered that guilty members of tent clans be tattooed according to tribal precedent.

literal: On yiwei day, made Liu Shenxing Southern Privy Commissioner, Southern Chancellery chancellor Xing Baozhi to know Southern Privy Commissioner affairs.
idiomatic: On yiwei day Liu Shenxing was appointed Southern Privy Commissioner and Southern Chancellery chancellor Xing Baozhi was assigned to manage Southern Privy Commissioner affairs.

literal: In the sixth month, on gengxu day, elevated Wei Prefecture and Li Prefecture to observation commission status.
idiomatic: On gengxu day of the sixth month Wei Prefecture and Li Prefecture were elevated to observation commissions.

literal: On yimao day, King of Han Yelü Shilu died.
idiomatic: On yimao day King of Han Yelü Shilu died.

literal: On bingchen day, made Southern Chancellery Great King Huage Northern Privy Commissioner.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Southern Chancellery Great King Huage was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner.

literal: On dingji day, edict ordered Northwestern Pacification commissioner and imperial son-in-law Xiao Tuyu to pacify the western frontier.
idiomatic: On dingji day an edict ordered Northwestern Pacification commissioner and imperial son-in-law Xiao Tuyu to pacify the western frontier.

literal: Established Zubu various tribes military commissioners.
idiomatic: Military commissioners were established for the various Zubu tribes.

literal: That autumn, hunted at Pingdi Songlin.
idiomatic: That autumn the court hunted at Pingdi Songlin.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on gengzi new moon, imperial halt at Guangping Marsh.
idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Guangping Marsh.

literal: On jiayin day, posthumously granted Grand Chancellor King of Jin Yelü Longyun Palace Secretary, posthumous title Wenzhong.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Grand Chancellor King of Jin Yelü Longyun was posthumously made Palace Secretary and given the posthumous title Wenzhong.

literal: In the eleventh month, on gengwu new moon, favored visit to Xian Prefecture.
idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the eleventh month the court visited Xian Prefecture.

literal: In the twelfth month, on gengzi new moon, again went to Guangping Marsh.
idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the twelfth month the court again went to Guangping Marsh.

literal: On guichou day, because Associate Southern Privy Commissioner Xing Baozhi was old in years, edict ordered riding small cart to attend court.
idiomatic: On guichou day, because Xing Baozhi, who managed Southern Privy Commissioner affairs, was advanced in years, an edict allowed him to attend court in a small cart.

literal: That month, established Gui and Ning two prefectures.
idiomatic: That month Gui and Ning Prefectures were established.

literal: That year, palace examination, released Gao Chengyan and two others passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year Gao Chengyan and two others passed the palace examination.

literal: In the first year of Kaitai, spring, first month, on jisi new moon, Song dispatched Zhao Xiang, Fu Chenghan to come congratulate.
idiomatic: In the first year of Kaitai, on the jisi new moon of the first spring month Song sent Zhao Xiang and Fu Chenghan with congratulations.

literal: On guiwei day, Changbai Mountain thirty divisions Jurchen chieftains came with tribute, begged granted ranks; granted.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Jurchen chieftains of the thirty divisions of Changbai Mountain came with tribute and asked for ranks and titles; their request was granted.

literal: On jiashen day, imperial halt at Prince's Courtyard.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the court encamped at Prince's Courtyard.

literal: On bingxu day, paid respects at Muye Mountain from afar.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the court worshipped at Muye Mountain from afar.

literal: On dinghai day, Jurchen Grand Guardian Punian and others came to court.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Jurchen Grand Guardian Punian and others came to court.

literal: On wuzi day, hunted at Maiheru Forest.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the court hunted at Maiheru Forest.

literal: On gengyin day, sacrificed at Muye Mountain.
idiomatic: On gengyin day sacrifice was performed at Muye Mountain.

literal: On xinmao day, Yisuguan Great King Yilixi came to court.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Yisuguan Great King Yilixi came to court.

literal: In the second month, on renzi day, imperial halt at Ruilu Plain.
idiomatic: On renzi day of the second month the court encamped at Ruilu Plain.

literal: In the third month, on jiaxu day, made Wei Prefecture an observation commission, not subordinate to Wuding Army.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the third month Wei Prefecture was made an observation commission independent of the Wuding Army.

literal: On yihai day, went to Wei Marsh.
idiomatic: On yihai day the court went to Wei Marsh.

literal: On dingchou day, edict enfeoffed eight imperial daughters as commandery princesses.
idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict enfeoffed eight imperial daughters as commandery princesses.

literal: On yiyou day, edict to select day soon to perform mountain worship and great willow-shooting rites, ordered Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Prince of Lanling Xiao Ning, Privy Commissioner and Minister of Works Xing Baozhi to supervise the relevant offices in preparing ritual objects.
idiomatic: On yiyou day an edict ordered a date chosen for the mountain-worship and great willow-shooting rites and directed Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Prince of Lanling Xiao Ning and Privy Commissioner and Minister of Works Xing Baozhi to supervise the relevant offices in preparing the ritual equipment.

literal: On dinghai day, the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou was transferred enfeoffment to Prince of Qi, remaining to guard Eastern Capital.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Prince of Chu Longyou was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Qi and left to guard the Eastern Capital.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on gengzi day, Goryeo dispatched Cai Zhongshun to come, begged to call self subject as before; edict ordered King Xun personally come to court.
idiomatic: On gengzi day of the fourth summer month Goryeo sent Cai Zhongshun asking to resume vassal status as before; an edict ordered King Xun to come to court in person.

literal: On renchen day, Xia State dispatched envoys presenting good horses.
idiomatic: On renchen day Western Xia sent envoys presenting fine horses.

literal: On jiyou day, sacrificed to the Wind Lord.
idiomatic: On jiyou day sacrifice was offered to the Wind Lord.

literal: On xinyou day, made former Mengfu House Changwen Xiao Fonu Left yilibi.
idiomatic: On xinyou day former Mengfu House changwen Xiao Fonu was appointed Left yilibi.

literal: In the fifth month, on wuchen new moon, returned to Upper Capital.
idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the fifth month the court returned to the Upper Capital.

literal: Edict ordered Pei Xuangan, Xing Xiang to supervise Ministry of Rites examinations, released jinshi Shi Jian and nineteen others passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: An edict put Pei Xuangan and Xing Xiang in charge of the Ministry of Rites examinations; nineteen jinshi including Shi Jian passed and were granted degrees.

literal: Made imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong Zheng Prefecture defense commissioner.
idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was appointed defense commissioner of Zheng Prefecture.

literal: On yihai day, made Xing Baozhi Datong Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On yihai day Xing Baozhi was appointed military commissioner of the Datong Army.

literal: In the sixth month, imperial halt at Upper Capital.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the court encamped at the Upper Capital.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingzi day, made Yelü Suizhen Liaoxing Army military commissioner, Suizheng Northern Chancellery Xuanhui commissioner, Zhang Zhaoying Southern Chancellery Xuanhui commissioner, Yelü Shouyi Upper Capital vice garrison commander, Kou Qing Zhangde Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the seventh autumn month Yelü Suizhen was made military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army, Suizheng Northern Chancellery xuanhui commissioner, Zhang Zhaoying Southern Chancellery xuanhui commissioner, Yelü Shouyi Upper Capital vice garrison commander, and Kou Qing military commissioner of the Zhangde Army.

literal: Ordered Yelü Shishennu, Li Cao as birthday congratulation envoys to Song, Xiao Niegun and Qi Tai as New Year's Day congratulation envoys to Song.
idiomatic: Yelü Shishennu and Li Cao were appointed birthday congratulation envoys to Song, and Xiao Niegun and Qi Tai New Year's Day congratulation envoys to Song.

literal: Jinshi Kang Wenzhao, Zhang Suchen, Lang Xuanda sat for discussing examination supervisor Pei Xuangan and Xing Xiang private partiality; Secretariat regular script compiler Li Wan submitted memorial, words involved resentment and slander; all were flogged and banished, Wan was conscripted to fall into River Ironworks.
idiomatic: Jinshi Kang Wenzhao, Zhang Suchen, and Lang Xuanda were punished for criticizing examination supervisors Pei Xuangan and Xing Xiang for favoritism; Secretariat regular-script compiler Li Wan submitted a memorial whose language amounted to resentment and slander; all were flogged and banished, and Wan was conscripted to the River Ironworks.

literal: In the eighth month, on bingshen new moon, Iron Li Nasha and others sent more than one hundred Wurang households to Bin Prefecture, granted silk fabrics.
idiomatic: On the bingshen new moon of the eighth month Iron Li Nasha and others sent more than one hundred Wurang households to Bin Prefecture and were granted silk fabrics.

literal: That day, Nasha begged granted Buddha image and Confucian books; edict granted Protect-the-Nation Benevolent-King Buddha Image one, Book of Changes, Classic of Poetry, Book of Documents, Spring and Autumn Annals, Record of Rites each one set.
idiomatic: That day Nasha asked for a Buddha image and Confucian texts; an edict granted one Protect-the-Nation Benevolent-King Buddha Image and one set each of the Book of Changes, Classic of Poetry, Book of Documents, Spring and Autumn Annals, and Record of Rites.

literal: On jiwei day, Goryeo King Xun dispatched Tian Gongzhi submitting memorial, claimed illness unable to come to court; edict again took six prefectures' land.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Goryeo King Xun sent Tian Gongzhi with a memorial claiming illness and inability to come to court; an edict ordered the six prefectures' territory seized again.

literal: That month, Prince of Qi Longyou died; court mourning halted five days.
idiomatic: That month Prince of Qi Longyou died, and court was suspended for five days.
